spec_owner: interop-vector owns .ai/SVG import and export (STU-IO-186); press owns PDF reading (read_vector_document, its own content walk in vector_source.rs) and PDF writing; folio owns swatch, ICC, story, type-style, clip and mask records; harness is the host adapter and editing surface
capabilities_done: (1) text as text: press glyph draws carry font (PostScript name, embedded TrueType/OpenType/CFF bytes, 64 MiB cap), glyph id, Unicode (ToUnicode, glyph names) and glyph matrix; interop-vector groups upright filled glyphs of one font/size/colour/baseline (gaps up to 1.5 em) into runs and asks PdfDrawingProvider::text_as_text for a font that lays the run out as placed; the harness answers by shaping with Type (as text::prepare draws): the embedded program with the same glyph ids and pen offsets within 2 % of the size (PdfTextFont::Embedded, the font kept in the vector entry member fonts and registered on open), else a viewer font registered under the PDF font's PostScript name with matching offsets (PdfTextFont::Installed); a kept run is a Folio text layer + StudioTextStory + paragraph/character StudioTypeStyle (size and origin in document px, linear-light fill) in the session entry text; otherwise one outline layer per run (ai_text_as_outlines)

(2) AI layers: press walks the page content with its own object model in the interpreter's order (forms followed through Do, depth 8), checks each BMC/BDC against hayro's marked-content callbacks and brackets the outermost /OC groups (BeginLayer/EndLayer); hidden layers are read from an all-visible copy (/D BaseState /ON, no /OFF) written by PdfDoc; interop-vector makes each a named group layer under the artboard group, hidden when off (nested brackets flattened, ai_layer_nested_flattened)

(3) document colours: the same walk keeps each solid path's written colour (gray, RGB, CMYK, Lab with white point, ICC-based with the profile bytes, Separation ink with its alternate at full tint for exponential tint transforms), checked event by event against hayro (counts, pattern vs colour, gray/RGB values; any disagreement drops the page's sources, pdf_source_colour_unmatched); interop-vector writes Folio StudioSwatch records (process CMYK/gray/Lab with profile_ref for ICC CMYK/gray, spot inks with alternate) bound by StudioSwatchPaint (spot tint as per-use tint; the RGB row stays the stand-in) and StudioIccProfile records, the /OutputIntents profile marked working_space; the harness carries the profile bytes in the vector entry icc member, so swatches re-resolve after save/reopen

(4) clip and mask export: harness make_clip / make_vector_mask / release_masks author Folio StudioVectorClip / StudioVectorMask + attachments (source hidden); PDF export now walks the layer tree bottom-most first: clips and VECTOR masks are PDF clip paths of the source geometry (inverted VECTOR masks even-odd in the page rectangle), ALPHA and LUMINANCE masks a group soft mask (an image of the mask plane rasterised with nib at document resolution, inverted and region-limited as recorded), group opacity/blend transparency groups; SVG export goes through interop-vector export_proposal_with_loss: the layer tree, clipPath for clips and VECTOR masks, mask for ALPHA/LUMINANCE

list: press tests/vector_read.rs documents_keep_source_colours_layers_and_glyph_text (hand-assembled PDF: two OCGs one off, CMYK, Lab, ICC CMYK output intent, spot with type-2 tint transform; glyph id/unicode/matrix/font bytes from a PdfExport fixture; hostile byte cap and cancel)

gaps: text: point text only, one run per line; area/path text, paragraph structure, tracking/kerning beyond what shaping reproduces, and text colours other than RGB/gray stay outlines or RGB; Press-written and most Illustrator subsets have no character map, so they stay text only with an installed font of the same PostScript name
layers: only optional-content groups at page level; AI sublayers and private data are a typed loss; OCMD visibility policies other than plain groups are read as visible

colours: DeviceN, Indexed, CalRGB/CalGray and ICC RGB stay converted RGB (pdf_colour_converted); spot alternates of non-exponential tint transforms are not read; spot alternates in ICC spaces lose the profile; Lab white points other than D50 are kept as written (pdf_lab_white_point_not_d50); gradient stops stay converted RGB

masks on export: ALPHA/LUMINANCE masks are rasterised at document resolution in PDF; mask_clip and mask parameters are reported, not exported; inverted VECTOR masks are not exported to SVG (vector_mask_not_exported); soft masks and images inside an imported .ai are still not read
make_clip / make_vector_mask take two undo steps (source visibility, then records)
